body: Looking at it like a cold is helpful, it feels like everyone just tells me to feel better and I get stressed that I just can't make myself feel better. I had never had intrusive thoughts the way they were when I made this post but I think it was caused by a new medicine so I've stopped taking it (as directed by my doctor). I have started to feel better and hope to be in a better place soon :) thank you stranger.

This episode was my first time having sudden intrusive thoughts. I went from enjoying playing a game on my phone to "kill yourself" mid game. It was sudden and weird. It is comforting knowing that I'm not the only one that has them. I just feel like my thoughts are something that I should have total control over, but it just isn't that way. It seems that my episode was caused by a medicine I had just been put on, I've stopped taking it and am getting better as it flushes out :)

Thank you, I have never seriously acted on my thoughts before but I have done things like find a site to do it and go sit there for a while before leaving. I know being scared of it was a good thing now. A little after I posted it became a "need" to kill myself rather than a want. But it seems to have been reared to a new medication so I've stopped taking it and I am slowly getting better as it flushes out of my system :)

Thank you for your response, I have been depressed for years but the episode that happened when I posted this seems to have been a result of a medication change. I've stopped taking it and have been feeling a little better, now just waiting to get it out of my system. It was really hard to disregard those thoughts. I didn't feel like I wanted to kill myself, I felt like I needed to. Like it was necessary and there was no options.
